baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form أَلْقَىٰ is anchored in ل ق ي as casting something before another, while مَعَاذِيرَهُ is anchored in ع ذ ر as claims seeking removal of blame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The concession externalizes defense: the person can cast a collection of exculpatory claims into the encounter as if placing objects before an evaluator.

activation_trace.role: Casting or setting something before another supplies the physical presentation of the defense.
An excuse seeking removal of blame supplies the presented object's legal-affective purpose.

changed_reading.before: Even if he offers his excuses.
changed_reading.after: Even if he casts a bundle of exculpatory claims before the encounter as a defensive submission.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَلْقَىٰ can denote imparting speech, and the ع ذ ر inventory includes a displayed excuse that masks shortcoming.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object cast is not merely a reason but manufactured speech: a prompted or delivered verbal performance whose apparent excuse may itself be feigned.

activation_trace.role: Imparting or prompting speech makes the casting a speech-production event.
A feigned excuse accompanying shortcoming makes the delivered speech potentially performative rather than exculpatory.

changed_reading.before: He states reasons in his defense.
changed_reading.after: He delivers ready-made pretexts, turning excuse-making into a verbal performance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus combines ل ق ي casting with the ع ذ ر branch of traces fading or being effaced.
baseline_models.mechanism: Excuse-making can be materially pictured as casting an erasure over residual evidence, an attempt to make the incriminating trace disappear rather than to answer it.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the deliberate overlay or deployment.
The fading and effacement of traces supplies the attempted evidentiary result.

changed_reading.before: He offers an explanation for what he did.
changed_reading.after: He tries to erase what his acts left behind by casting an effacing counter-account over their traces.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exact plural مَعَاذِير has a packet branch meaning curtains or coverings, paired with أَلْقَىٰ as casting or setting something down.
baseline_models.mechanism: The defense becomes a visibility operation. He may cast coverings up to conceal himself, or cast them down and stand exposed; the verb leaves that directional contrast live.

activation_trace.role: Casting or putting down supplies the ambiguous placement or removal of a covering.
The exact-plural curtain image turns verbal excuses into material screens.

changed_reading.after: Even if he manipulates his coverings, either screening himself or throwing the screens down.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ع ذ ر inventory places ordinary excuse beside a branch in which a person becomes full of faults and sins; أَلْقَىٰ makes those contents an emitted presentation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The defense can invert itself: multiplying excuses may cast out not acquittal but further manifestations of the fault-bearing self.

activation_trace.role: Casting makes each attempted defense a fresh outward act.
Being full of faults and sins permits the excuse-root to invert from exculpation into additional fault.

changed_reading.after: The very production of excuses may disclose and multiply the faults it is meant to remove.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding clause locates perceptive testimony within the person's own self. The cast excuses therefore do not merely fail before an external evaluator; they collide with an inward witness already coextensive with the accused.

activation_trace.role: The outwardly cast defense supplies one side of the collision.
The bid to remove blame supplies what the internal witness defeats.
The self as the very identity of the thing makes the witness inseparable from the accused.
Insight of the heart supplies inward perception rather than merely external eyesight.

structural_cues: 75:14 states the self-insight immediately before 75:15's concessive ولو, so the concession tests whether excuses can overcome that testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-identity, inward sight, and a cast excuse; I infer that inward sight functions as testimony against the outward plea. A live alternative is simply that self-knowledge and excuse-making are juxtaposed without a witness mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Even a submitted plea cannot persuade the judge.
changed_reading.after: Even a submitted plea cannot detach the person from the inward witness that already sees from within the accused self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding movement asks for escape, denies any shelter, and fixes the destination. The excuses become a last portable refuge cast into a spatial sequence in which neither flight nor protective emplacement remains available.

activation_trace.role: Casting makes the plea a last object projected toward possible protection.
Seeking removal of blame supplies the plea's protective function.
Flight and escape establish the attempted outward route.
The denied refuge removes a place in which the defense could shelter its maker.
Fixity and settlement replace attempted flight with an unavoidable endpoint.

structural_cues: 75:10-12 forms a compact route from requested escape, through denied refuge, to fixed destination before the disclosure and excuse sequence of 75:13-15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escape, no refuge, fixed settlement, and a cast plea; I infer that the plea functions as a substitute shelter after physical shelter fails. It may alternatively remain purely forensic rather than spatial.

changed_reading.before: He offers reasons to avoid blame.
changed_reading.after: After every route and shelter closes, he casts excuses as a final portable refuge, but the destination is already fixed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person is delivered news spanning what was put forward and what was held back. Excuses now read as a late counter-narrative thrown against a temporally complete account, not as missing information that might repair it.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the late counter-submission.
The excuse supplies the attempted revision of blame.
A report arriving and being delivered makes the prior account already available.
Advancing and precedence cover what the person sent ahead.
Deferral to a later time covers what the person postponed or left behind.

structural_cues: 75:13's paired قدم/أخر exhausts the before-after span immediately before self-testimony and the failed excuse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivered news and a before-after pair; I infer completeness and treat the excuse as a later attempt to edit that record. The pair may denote categories of deeds without implying a documentary record.

changed_reading.before: The excuse may supply a fact the evaluator has not considered.
changed_reading.after: The excuse is a belated rewrite cast against an account that already spans what was advanced and delayed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening reconstructs what was dispersed, with capacity extending to the leveling of minute extremities. Against that sequence, the focus branch of effaced traces becomes an attempted forensic erasure that exact reassembly can reverse.

activation_trace.role: Effacement of traces supplies the attempted destruction of residual evidence.
Casting supplies the agentive act of laying that erasure over the trace.
Gathering dispersed parts supplies the primary reversal of loss and scattering.
Effective capacity supplies the power that makes reconstruction operative.
Completion and right formation make reconstruction exact rather than approximate.
The body's extremities supply the fine-grained limit case of recovered detail.

structural_cues: 75:3-4 answers denied bodily gathering with an emphatic claim of exact reconstruction before 75:13-15 turns to disclosure and excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trace-effacement, gathering, capacity, completion, and extremity-detail; I infer that bodily reconstruction analogically guarantees evidentiary reconstruction. The live alternative confines 75:3-4 to resurrection without an evidence-recovery arrow.

changed_reading.before: He tries to blur the traces of his conduct with an excuse.
changed_reading.after: He casts an erasure over the traces, but the same power that regathers and precisely reforms dispersed bodily detail can recover what he effaces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence restrains a moving, hasty tongue and replaces it with gathering, recitation, following, and clarification. This activates ألقى as imparted speech: excuses become hurried self-authored counter-speech set against an ordered discourse whose collection and explanation are not controlled by the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Imparting or prompting speech lets the excuse be heard as delivered counter-recitation.
The feigned-excuse branch gives the hurried counter-speech its defensive unreliability.
The tongue as the organ of speech supplies the bodily production channel.
Haste supplies the uncontrolled timing of the rival speech act.
Gathering dispersed material supplies ordered collection before delivery.
Reading and recitation supply the controlled discourse contrasted with improvised excuses.
Following trace after trace supplies receptive sequence instead of anticipatory speech.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign reserves final explanation for the ordered discourse.

structural_cues: 75:16-19 immediately interrupts the judgment sequence with a second speech-control sequence: restrain haste, gather, recite, follow, then clarify.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech-casting branch and the ordered tongue-to-clarification sequence; I infer a contrast between defensive counter-speech and authoritative disclosure. The materially live alternative is a referent break: 75:16-19 may address recitation alone and not characterize the human excuses of 75:15.

changed_reading.before: The person simply voices excuses after being confronted.
changed_reading.after: The person rushes out self-authored counter-speech, while the surrounding discourse assigns gathering, recitation, sequence, and clarification elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The curtain branch in the exact focus plural is followed by promised disclosure and by faces that visibly polarize into radiance or grimness. Verbal defenses become screens that cannot govern what is made manifest on the public face.

activation_trace.role: Curtains or coverings supply the attempted visual concealment.
Casting supplies either deploying the screen or throwing it down.
Appearance and uncovering supply the counter-operation to screening.
The face as the presented front supplies the public surface on which state becomes legible.
Radiant freshness supplies one involuntary visible outcome.
Facial grimness and aversion supply the opposed involuntary visible outcome.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from excuses at 75:15 to بيان at 75:19 and then to two visibly opposed classes of faces at 75:22-24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies curtains, uncovering, and visibly changed faces; I infer that excuses function as screens defeated by manifestation. If ألقى means throwing the curtains down, the same cues instead portray compelled self-exposure rather than failed concealment.

changed_reading.before: He places verbal reasons between himself and blame.
changed_reading.after: He manipulates curtains of defense, but clarification uncovers and the face publicly displays what the screen was meant to control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later diagnosis pairs attachment to what is immediate with leaving what is later. The feigned speech model therefore shifts from a post-event plea to an ongoing rationalization system that protects immediate appetite by discounting deferred consequence.

activation_trace.role: Delivered speech supplies the rationalizing narrative.
A displayed but unreal excuse supplies the narrative's self-protective distortion.
Speed and precedence supply preference for the immediate.
Leaving something supplies the active abandonment of deferred consequence.
Laterness after what comes first supplies the discounted horizon.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 gives a causal-looking preference pair after the excuse and recitation sequences: love the immediate, leave the later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediacy, leaving, laterness, and feigned speech; I infer that excuses mediate the preference by making present choice narratively acceptable. Alternatively, 75:15 may concern only final-day pleading, with no claim about earlier rationalization.

changed_reading.before: Excuses are improvised only after the person is exposed.
changed_reading.after: Excuses are the verbal technology by which immediate desire is repeatedly made acceptable while later consequence is left aside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later behavioral verdict opposes realized confirmation with attribution to falsehood and turning away. Under that pattern, casting excuses is not neutral advocacy: it can reenact the same denial and withdrawal, so the attempted defense becomes another fault-bearing act.

activation_trace.role: The excuse-root's fault-filled branch permits attempted exculpation to carry additional culpability.
Casting makes the defense itself a fresh performed act.
Realizing truth in action supplies the omitted positive response.
Attributing the matter to falsehood supplies active denial rather than mere uncertainty.
Turning away supplies the withdrawal that the defensive act repeats.

structural_cues: 75:31-32 gives a balanced negation/contrast: no enacted confirmation, but denial and turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fault-bearing ع ذ ر, casting, unrealized confirmation, denial, and withdrawal; I infer that the excuse is another iteration of that conduct. A live alternative treats the excuse as evidentially useless but not itself a new offense.

changed_reading.before: The excuses fail to subtract earlier blame.
changed_reading.after: By casting a denial-shaped defense, the person may repeat the very false attribution and turning away for which he answers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from forensic speech into a coarse material image, but it is anchored by the focus verb's casting branch and the ع ذ ر branch that links a courtyard to waste thrown there. Downstream prose should mark it as a branch-generated analogy, not translate مَعَاذِير as excrement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَلْقَىٰ supplies throwing, while the focus ع ذ ر inventory supplies courtyard refuse named from what is thrown there.

activation_trace.role: Throwing or casting supplies the disposal action.
Courtyard refuse named through what is thrown there supplies the degraded material value of the discarded defense.

changed_reading.before: He dignifies his case by presenting reasons.
changed_reading.after: He dumps verbal refuse into the encounter; the quantity of thrown material does not raise its evidentiary worth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the neck-and-hand bond branch is associated with العذارى rather than the exact focus plural, yet it remains root-anchored and gains an unusually specific echo from gathering hands to necks, bodily wrapping, and being driven. Render only as a contained material analogy: excuses behave like self-bonds or bonds one vainly tries to cast off, not as a lexical claim about مَعَاذِير.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs casting in ل ق ي with the ع ذ ر branch of bonds joining hands to necks.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies either putting bonds forward or attempting to throw them off.
Neck-and-hand bonds supply the material consequence into which excuse-making may invert.
A restraint gathering hands to the neck independently repeats the unusually specific focus branch image.
One thing wrapped around another extends the bodily restraint image.
Driving and herding supply compelled movement after attempted self-release.

changed_reading.before: Excuses are tools by which the person tries to free himself.
changed_reading.after: Excuses can become self-bonds; even casting them off does not prevent the wrapped and driven bodily passage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a scar or livestock brand onto forensic identification, but the mark branch is in the focus root inventory and context foregrounds exact extremity detail plus inward sight. Downstream prose should describe an evidentiary analogy in which defense turns exhibit, not assert that مَعَاذِير literally means fingerprints or scars here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ع ذ ر inventory includes a distinguishing scar or brand, and أَلْقَىٰ can set such an item before another.

activation_trace.role: A scar or distinguishing brand supplies identity-bearing evidence.
Setting something before another turns the identifying mark into an exhibit.
The body's extremities supply the context's insistence on individuated bodily detail.
Inward insight makes the identifying evidence readable from within as well as without.

changed_reading.before: The person casts evidence intended to distinguish his case from blame.
changed_reading.after: What he casts as defense can function like an identifying mark, attaching the case more precisely to him.

strongest_changes: The preceding self-insight turns an external plea into a collision with an inseparable internal witness.
The before-after report makes excuses belated counter-narratives against a temporally comprehensive disclosure.
Repeated exact reconstruction activates trace-erasure as a failed attempt to destroy recoverable evidence.
The immediate tongue/recitation sequence makes excuse-casting hurried counter-speech opposed to gathered, followed, and clarified discourse.
The exact-plural curtain branch, later disclosure, and visibly polarized faces make excuse-making a failed control of visibility.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context did more than confirm that excuses fail: it redistributed the focus across evidence, refuge, speech control, temporal preference, bodily reconstruction, and visibility while preserving several coexisting mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: أَلْقَىٰ can project, place, or throw down, so covering models retain both concealment and compelled exposure.
The transition at 75:16 may be a referent break; the counter-recitation model is mechanistically strong but not a claim of continuous human speech.
Trace, curtain, fault, refuse, bond, and mark branches vary in form-distance from the exact noun and must not be promoted from activations into unqualified lexical glosses.
Several context arrows are analogical: bodily reassembly need not itself assert evidentiary reconstruction, and later denial need not make every excuse a new offense.
